normative_extracts.quote: The touch-action CSS property determines whether touch input may trigger default behavior supplied by the user agent, such as panning or zooming.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: CSS touch-action instructs the compositor up front which gestures belong to the browser vs JS, preventing pointercancel during custom drags.

production_failures.symptom: Custom touch drag stops firing pointermove after 10px on mobile
production_failures.root_cause: Without touch-action: none (or pan-y), the browser claims the touch gesture for native scrolling and fires pointercancel.
production_failures.mitigation: Declare touch-action: none on draggable handles and call setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) on pointerdown.

production_failures.symptom: Dragging cursor outside a small slider thumb drops pointerup and leaves UI stuck in drag state
production_failures.root_cause: Pointer events target the element under the cursor unless captured; fast mouse movement exits the thumb before pointerup.
production_failures.mitigation: Call target.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) on pointerdown so pointermove and pointerup route to the handle.
